description: Field summaries, loop state normalization, branch ownership facts, demanded projections, and additional memory checks. Native macOS ARM64. Python compiler frozen.
measurement_notes: Paired sequential warm local samples use identical updated inputs and flags; three samples per engine/project.
Upstream timings are loaded integration measurements; native test/build time and repeated convention validation are included. They are not isolated runtime benchmarks.
Corpus reports retain successful results within this hardening round, with affected configurations rerun after later fixes; compiler hashes are recorded per repository.
Seven build configurations have no usable native baseline. Three native crash/unavailable runtime configurations were not re-executed; separate compile coverage remains recorded.
Unverified warnings are review boundaries, not confirmed defects. Counts by recipe include repeated source under different configurations.

local_audit.method: Same updated sources and flags in both engines; sequential paired warm samples; backend two threads. No warning suppressions added.
